title: Second round of Genesis Mission selections includes 12 Phase II awards
summary: The Department of Energy has announced the selection of 12 new Phase II awards and six new Phase I awards through its Genesis Mission, including projects related to fusion energy and high-radiation environments. In July, the DOE announced the selection of 278 projects under the Genesis Mission, most of which were Phase I projects. Phase II awards are intended to scale up and expand projects that have already demonstrated potential for transformative scientific capability through multi-year funding.

title: Canada: City opposes deep repository designation; court denies NSDF challenge
summary: Two recent developments in Ontario, Canada, could have ramifications for the country’s efforts to dispose of its legacy nuclear waste. In the province’s western half, the city of Dryden voted to formally request that Canada’s Major Projects Office deny “project of national interest” status for a proposal for a nearby deep geological repository. To the east, Canada’s Federal Court of Appeal ruled that the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission did not have an expanded duty to consult the Kebaowek First Nation regarding construction of the Near Surface Disposal Facility (NSDF) near Chalk River Laboratories, 200 kilometers northwest of Ottawa. It also upheld the CNSC’s initial approval of the NSDF site.

title: Westinghouse To Invest $1 Billion In New US Higher Enrichment Nuclear Fuel Facility
summary: Westinghouse Electric Company has announced an investment of approximately $1bn (€890m) in a new manufacturing facility for low-enriched uranium plus (LEU+) nuclear fuel at its existing Columbia fuel fabrication site in South Carolina, a statement said. The company said construction has begun at the site near Hopkins. Production is scheduled to start in 2030.

title: In latest Indiana power plant proposal, parties to explore CANDU reactors
summary: Indiana, the Hoosier Energy Rural Electric Cooperative, and Montreal-based nuclear engineering company AtkinsRéalis have signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to partner up and explore the feasibility of an Indiana nuclear power plant with up to eight CANDU reactors. If deployed, the nuclear facility could provide up to 6 GW of new nuclear capacity.

title: Nuclear Industry Calls For Concrete Action In EU Post-2030 Energy Framework
summary: Senior executives from Europe’s nuclear industry have called on the European Commission to take “concrete steps” to support nuclear investments under the EU’s post-2030 energy and climate framework, including a common clean energy target covering both nuclear power and renewables. In a letter dated 19 October to European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen, the executives urged the EU to move away from technology-specific targets and ensure that all low-carbon energy sources receive equal policy support.

title: Centrus Announces $116 Million Acquisition Of Centrifuge Component Supplier Westerman
summary: US nuclear fuel company Centrus Energy has acquired Westerman Holdings, a major supplier of components for its uranium enrichment centrifuges, for about $116m (€103m), a statement said. Centrus said the acquisition was financed through about $95m in cash and $21m in equity.
